name: Flair USA
old_description: Vertically integrated for full product development & customer-focused innovation
about:
Founded in 1992 in Appleton, Wisconsin, Flair Packaging (operating as Flair USA) is a privately held, family-owned manufacturer of flexible packaging. The company began as a market-driven operation focused on customer-focused innovation and has grown into a vertically integrated supplier with facilities across North America and Asia.

Flair produces rollstock films, pouches, bags, sustainable packaging, and tactile packaging from its integrated facilities, which include an extrusion plant, converting lines, an analytical laboratory, and an application lab. The company added 10-color flexo printing and solventless lamination at its 35,000-square-foot Calgary plant and operates additional sites in Lacey, Washington; Tlajomulco, Jalisco; Seoul and Pyeongtaek, South Korea. Capabilities span COEX and laminated films, lidding and thermoforming films, vacuum pouches, rotogravure printing, and custom structures engineered for hot-fill, high-pressure processing, and retort applications.

The company serves food and nonfood brands across categories including meat and poultry, seafood, cheese and dairy, prepared foods, snacks and sweets, baby foods, grains and spices, fruits and vegetables, coffee and tea, liquids and spreads, pet care, and foodservice. A stock program offers unprinted, ready-to-label formats such as FlairPak vacuum pouches and rollstock lidding films with lower minimums and faster lead times from strategically located warehouses.

Flair emphasizes collaborative innovation, controlling quality from extrusion through conversion, and holds FSSC 22000 certification (GFSI-recognized) with FDA, USDA, and CFIA compliance. Its ACTIV8 oxygen-absorber sachets and PE mono-material recyclable coffee bags illustrate a focus on shelf-life extension and sustainability.
